scope: Indexed draw CPU bounds now come from declaration extents, stream byte lengths/offsets/strides and per-instance divisors, with checked signed base arithmetic and constant-stream handling. The shared bound kernel performs no index reads. Original optional MinVertexIndex/NumVertices fields remain on the wire, including zero, unrelated and overflowing hints. Software ClipStatus continues to include unreferenced vertices of a trustworthy declared hint range; unusable/out-of-hint ranges allow GPU rendering but make the proxy query unavailable rather than scanning the complete VB or dereferencing unsafe addresses. Subsequent valid software draws recover the query; transformed draws preserve their existing status behavior. This fallback is an explicit proxy policy, not a native Microsoft ClipStatus observation. Six known primitive types with zero count succeed without range reads, draws or mirror invalidation after required bindings/format guards. D3D8 Set/GetIndices and deferred recording preserve the full UINT base pattern; draw arithmetic interprets its bits as signed following Wine. D3D8 no-IB indexed calls follow Wine no-op behavior, while the existing D3D9 required-IB check is retained. Real XP validates eighteen known-color frames, two owners, signed-base queries and zero draw suppression; Metal and SwiftShader each pass 54 probes without GPU/host errors. XP TNL, state-block/lifetime and D3D9 typed/color/multi-stream processing regressions pass. This is partial S2-34: mapped/locked draw coherence still follows next, and UP/missing-binding/native-HAL edge contracts are not claimed complete. Guest wrappers, remaining stage 4 and stages 5/6 continue.
